Mega Man: Dual Override brings Mega Man back alongside Proto Man as a second playable hero, with each offering a distinct approach to combat. Players can equip more than 50 Custom Chips to modify their abilities and builds, while the new Override system lets both heroes temporarily push beyond their normal limits for a massive boost in power at the cost of becoming vulnerable afterward.

The latest mainline entry features a new lineup of eight Robot Masters, including Jet Man and the previously revealed Twinkle Girl, with defeating Robot Masters once again granting powerful Special Weapons. Starring Mark Ricci as Scratches the Cat, The Cat and the Hatchet is directed by Cameron Dodd, and produced by Mark Ricci and Kaleb Carmichael, with production from Six Side Studios and Prime Capitol. The short is a non-profit parody unauthorized or affiliated with the official IP.
